name: about-workshop-conversation-v1
prompt: Create an original polished Japanese manga illustration for a camper repair workshop's about section. Same mechanic as reference: adult Japanese man, wavy short black hair, subtle stubble, charcoal work coveralls with light stitching. He stands on RIGHT beside an ivory camper's open side service hatch, talking with the camper's driver on LEFT, an adult Japanese man wearing an olive outdoor jacket and beige trousers, holding vehicle keys. Mechanic gestures naturally toward the service hatch while driver listens and speaks. Both look AT EACH OTHER or toward the camper equipment, NO eye contact with viewer, NO posed frontal presentation. Medium-wide candid eye-level view, natural profiles, calm professional interaction, believable hands and tools. Friendly trustworthy repair workshop with open green garage bay and a few forest trees behind; NOT a picnic, no coffee or chairs. Show the ivory camper's window, door and rear portion to communicate camper repair clearly. Clean confident black ink contours, restrained flat cel shading, forest green, warm brown, ivory palette; no glossy 3D or painterly airbrush. Portrait 3:4 image with 15% clear scene room above heads and both heads and hands within the central 75% width, suitable for an arched-top website crop. Both characters' upper bodies and conversation are fully readable. No letters, signs, words, speech bubbles, numbers, logos, borders, watermarks.
